name: Amazon Textract
overview: Amazon Textract extracts printed/handwritten text and structured forms/tables from supported scanned documents and images.
examSignals: OCR plus forms/tables/key-value extraction from documents: Textract
NLP sentiment/entities after text extraction: Comprehend

compareWith.diff: Textract extracts document text and structure; Rekognition analyzes image/video visual content and labels.
